profile.description: The profile this MCP server serves; never the credential variable prefix

terminology.description: Display names of the two levels: `group` = {group}, `node` = {node}

nodes.description: The {nodes} of the {group} in config order

items.description: NodeSummary (data-model.md); never URLs, usernames or credentials

writeEnabled.description: Restart and kill allowed: write.enabled && (!production || productionOptIn); does not govern the development tools

developmentEnabled.description: Development tools allowed: `development.enabled && !production`; import_artifacts, restore_backup, set_active and tag_artifacts work on this {node}

repositoryWrite.description: Repository file tools may write: `development.repository` resolves to WRITE on a development {node}

versionLine.description: As configured: AUTO, V8_1, V9_X or a full version such as 8.1.17

cliAvailable.description: CLI home configured and startcli script found

Version.description: What this MCP server last learned about the INUBIT version and the StartCLI client of the {node} (from get_health and earlier tool calls; list_nodes contacts no {node}), the support status and the capabilities whose tools run on the {node}

setting.description: The configured versionLine: AUTO, V8_1, V9_X or a full version such as 8.1.17

server.description: The INUBIT version with its source and time, or `state` `not_yet_detected` (call get_health) or `unknown` with the error code of the last failed detection in `reason` and its time in `at`

client.description: The StartCLI client of the {node} as in get_health: its version, the declared INUBIT range and the comparison with the INUBIT version, or `state`: `not_available` (no StartCLI installation), `not_yet_detected` (not probed yet, or the probe timed out: `reason` TIMEOUT) or `unknown` (the probe failed: error code in `reason`)

status.description: supported: every capability the configuration allows is supported; partially_supported: some are usable, others unverified or not usable; unsupported: none is usable; unknown: the INUBIT version is not yet detected or unknown

capabilities.description: The capabilities the configuration of the {node} allows, split by whether their tools run on the {node} now (supported, or unverified for reads, and not refused by the StartCLI client)

notUsable.description: `inventory (StartCLI parts)`: inventory is usable for its REST part, but its StartCLI parts (modules, history) are refused

warnings.description: E.g. a versionLine contradicted by get_health, or a StartCLI client that differs from the INUBIT version
